parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment suggests that the authors should include experiments on open-sourced intelligent agents to address the issue of closed-source LLMs. This is an explicit action (include experiments) with a general direction (on open-sourced intelligent agents). However, the comment provides no concrete details on how to implement this action: it does not name specific open-source agents, experiments, metrics, or procedures, and the phrasing 'may be included' is merely a tentative suggestion. Authors would know what action to take but not exactly how to carry it out, so the comment is explicit but vague on execution, which corresponds to the level of the rubric where an explicit action is stated without concrete implementation details.
